related_information: If any failure code is displayed, perform troubleshooting for that code first.

steps.point_to_check: Leakage from injector (Reference: See “TESTING AND ADJUSTING”,“Testing fuel discharge, return and leakage”).
steps.remedy: • Replace injector. • Excessive dust may be in fuel. Confirm quality control of fuel.

steps.point_to_check: Check fuel return piping for clogging (injection amount increases for clogged fuel return piping).
steps.remedy: Fuel return piping repair or replacement

steps.point_to_check: • A low-temperature cylinder is found when touching the exhaust manifold right after the engine starts. • A cylinder running at the unchanged speed is found during operation in the cylinder cut-out mode. (Reference: See Testing and Adjusting, “Handle Cylinder Cut-out Mode Operation”.) REMARK If a black smoke is seen continuously during warmup operation after storage for a few days, injector may be defective.

steps.cause: Fuel leakage from inside of cylinder head
steps.point_to_check: • Check if oil level is increasing. • Check if there is smell of diesel fuel.

steps.cause: Fuel leakage supply pump oil seal part
steps.point_to_check: • Check if oil level is increasing or there is smell of diesel fuel. • Check supply pump oil seal.
Check for fuel leakage to outside of engine.
• Unspecified fuel filter is used. • Procedures described in Operation and Maintenance Manual are not observed when replacing fuel filter.
steps.remedy: • Use recommended fuel described in Operation and Maintenance Manual. • Observe procedures for replacing fuel filter described in Operation and Maintenance Manual.
